name: AAPC Certified Professional Coder

D2.name: E/M, anesthesia, radiology, lab, and medicine

realExamNote: The real CPC exam has 100 multiple-choice questions in 4 hours, including 10 multi-part coding cases, and is open-book (AMA CPT Professional Edition, ICD-10-CM and HCPCS Level II books). These practice exams test the guidelines and concepts you apply with those books, without the books. CPT is a registered trademark of the American Medical Association.
scoreNote: AAPC requires 70% (70 correct) to pass. Treat 70+ here as a readiness signal, and practice coding with your books too.
